story.title: From Hanoi's Old Quarters to Bangkok's Vibrant Culinary Center
story.p1: Ngon Lam ('Ngon Lắm' in Vietnamese translates to 'Delicious!') was founded on a simple dedication: bringing pure, uncompromised Vietnamese home cooking to Bangkok food lovers. Our founder traveled extensively across Hanoi and Saigon to master the delicate art of Phở spices — roasting star anise, cinnamon bark, and black cardamom to balance our signature broth.
story.p2: For more than 25 years at Chula Soi 9, our commitment remains unwavering. Every morning starts with simmering beef and poultry bones for over 12 hours to achieve natural sweetness without excessive seasoning. Our Nem Nướng is skewers grilled over real charcoal, paired with a secret sauce blended with liver pâté and toasted sesame.
story.p3: Whether you are a university student, an expat exploring Samyan, or a multi-generational family on your weekend feast, Ngon Lam welcomes you with authentic hospitality and enduring flavors.
